basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original opaque full-bleed 5:7 portrait oil painting for a medieval dark-fantasy civilization Practice card. Seek the storytelling compositional mastery of N. C. Wyeth and Dean Cornwell: one decisive action, bold silhouettes, monumental environmental scale, broad expressive visible oil brushwork, large calm color masses, and the sharpest contrast only at the action. Early twentieth-century adventure book painting, not photorealistic or glossy digital fantasy. Include two or three working human figures; all faces completely indiscernible, shown from behind, distant, or in deep shadow. Put the action, key tool or material, and principal figures in the UPPER CENTRAL 45 percent because game UI covers the lower half. The lower half is subdued and quiet. Clear at 70x100 pixels. No text, letters, symbols, decorative border, frame, interface, vignette, tiny clutter, or unrelated objects. Subject:

assets.irrigating: Three hooded workers open a heavy stone sluice high on a vast hillside, a single blue-white stream suddenly spilling into dry terraced fields. The joining hands and rushing water make one bright focal diagonal; the terraces stretch away at immense scale. Warm dusty earth, cool blue water.
assets.cropRotation: On a vast landscape of alternating dark and pale field strips, three small faceless farmers plant one newly turned strip beside a mature golden crop. One worker presses a large sheaf into the soil as another guides an ox; the contrasting adjacent bands tell the rotation story. Golden ochre focal strip under a cool broad sky.
assets.sheepHusbandry: Inside a huge shadowed timber sheep shed, three hooded workers shear one calm pale sheep. A broad bright fleece falling into a basket is the focal shape, with a larger flock only a quiet mass behind; heavy roof beams dwarf the people. Ivory wool against umber and grey-green.
assets.goatHerding: Three cloaked herders guide a pale goat herd across a narrow high mountain ledge. The leading goat leaps a gap at the instant one herder reaches with a crook; the figures are small against immense slate cliffs and misty valley. One light goat silhouette carries the focus, sparse dramatic composition.
assets.selectiveBreeding: In a vast wattle enclosure, three hooded animal keepers guide two especially strong young draft oxen into a small separate pen while a distant herd remains behind. A pale rope pulled taut between the chosen pair is the decisive focal line. Animals and people are readable silhouettes under a great dark barn arch; no faces.
assets.milling: Three hooded millers work beside an enormous turning stone mill wheel in a cavernous riverside mill. One person lifts a sack while a burst of pale flour pours from the chute into a waiting basin; that white arc is the sole bright focal point. Big dark wheel and beams show scale.
assets.saltGathering: Three small cloaked laborers rake brilliant white salt into one long mound on an immense mirrored salt flat. One worker lifts a basket of white crystals high in the upper center; flat horizon and distant water make the people tiny. Pale salt against broad muted blue-grey and ochre.
assets.saltCuring: In a tall shadowy curing house, three hooded workers suspend large strips of fish and meat from heavy racks while the lead worker throws a sweeping handful of bright white salt over them. The salt arc and one crimson strip form a controlled focal accent, vast dark rafters recede behind.
assets.butchering: In a rough stone abattoir, three faceless butchers work around a heavy wooden table, one raising a broad cleaver over a hanging side of meat. The pale cleaver and restrained red meat form one clear focal cross against deep brown shadow. Strong silhouettes and architectural scale, no gore or exposed entrails.
assets.blacksmithing: Three shadowed smiths forge a single broad sword blade at an enormous stone hearth. The hammer falls at the instant of orange sparks; blade and impact are the one brilliant focal shape. Vast forge chimney and heavy dark beams dwarf the people. Distinct sword, no spade.
assets.waterManagement: Three tiny hooded engineers open a great timber floodgate in a massive masonry dam. One forceful sheet of blue-white water bursts through while distant reservoir and terraces show enormous scale. The gate handle and flowing water are the sole sharp focus; broad slate stone and subdued land.
assets.glassmaking: In a cavernous dark glass furnace, three faceless artisans hold long blowing pipes; one glowing amber glass bubble expands at the pipe tip in the upper center. The delicate hot globe is the singular bright focal object against huge black furnace and cool slate shadow. Broad quiet lower half.
